findings.text: The task folder has no task.jsonl and no record of the test counts, but requirements.md asks for both: it holds only requirements.md, page.jsonl and review/diff.patch. A fresh agent cannot tell which tests ran or what they reported (placement.test.mjs was not mentioned at all); add the log lines and the 5-line counts.

Docs still describe the removed button. ux/Dictate/doc/pipeline.md:57 ("show raw one click down"), ux/Dictate/doc/single-voice-assistant.md:13 ("stay behind 'show raw'"), ux/Dictate/doc/steady-display.md:16 and :36 (the open "show raw" state), and ext/Chat/v2/readme.md:3 ("show raw") should say a tap on the message toggles its raw words. ux/Dictate/doc/principles.md:15 is already correct.

ChatV3.js:242 in the main tree still has the "show raw" button (it is only removed in the diff), and the diff leaves no sign that the worktree was merged; confirm it lands before this is called done. The ChatV3.test.mjs check at lines 50-53 is also the old version there.

The handler in ChatV3.js (prompt(), new lines ~205-211) returns early whenever any text is selected anywhere on the page. A leftover selection elsewhere (for example in a reply) makes the first tap on a pill do nothing. Checking that the selection sits inside the pill would be more exact.

The pill is a div with a click handler, so it cannot be reached or toggled from the keyboard and has no aria-expanded. This is acceptable for the touch-tap ask, but the raw words are now unreachable without a pointer.

The new cursor rule in bubbles.css:64 is shared with V1 and V2, and it is keyed off data-raw-tap, which only V3's prompt() sets. That is harmless, but the comment on that CSS line names a task slug and not the rule.

Requirement met on the diff's evidence: the button is gone, a tap toggles and a second tap hides, links, buttons and selections are ignored, and replies sit outside the pill so read-aloud is untouched. The red-test-first order and the test results could not be checked from the folder (see 1).

noted: the diff is on the worktree branch; it lands with this merge
fixed: the selection guard now only applies when the selection sits inside the pill; ChatV3 38/38 after
noted: keyboard access and aria-expanded are not built; ask was a touch tap; proposed in ai/todo.md
fixed: the css comment now states the rule, not a task slug
declined: not a defect, the change lives on the worktree branch and lands with this very merge; confirmed after merge
